name: Reworked Luck and Morale
description:
The mod expands the range of Luck and Morale to -4 at minimum and +4 at maximum.
Chances to trigger positive morale/luck effect are now 4.2, 8.3, 12.5, 16.7% at +1/2/3/4 morale/luck, respectively. Chances to trigger bad morale / luck effect are now 4.2, 8.3, 16.7, 25.0% at -1/2/3/4 morale / luck, respectively.
